evidence.title: Cisco IOS XE 17.17 Catalyst 9600 system-message logging examples
evidence.notes: Documents the %LINK-3-UPDOWN interface state message body. Outer PRI, hostname, and timestamp framing remain deployment-profile dependent.

evidence.title: Cisco Nexus 9000 link-flap troubleshooting
evidence.notes: Documents ETHPORT interface-down and interface-up lifecycle messages on Nexus 9000. Only message structures shown by Cisco are modeled.

evidence.title: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA syslog messages 302013 and 302014
evidence.notes: Documents TCP connection creation and teardown message structures. A connection event is not itself evidence of malicious activity.

evidence.title: NetSpout Phase 8C declarative multi-domain runtime validation
evidence.notes: Guarded native receiver, HEC, authenticated source-scoped Splunk, and investigation evidence is recorded in the Phase 8C report and accepted evidence summary.

known_limitations: The NetSpout-defined sourcetype is lab-only; current Cisco add-on sourcetype and CIM behavior are not claimed.
The outer syslog header is modeled and not asserted as a universal IOS XE wire prefix.

sources.format: NX-OS ETHPORT interface state syslog message
known_limitations: The NetSpout-defined sourcetype is lab-only; current add-on sourcetype and CIM behavior are not claimed.
Link-state messages do not by themselves establish application impact or root cause.

references.title: Campus Access Link Degradation — IOS XE Reference
references.story: A fictional Catalyst campus uplink transitions down and recovers while the lab preserves the Cisco-documented LINK-3-UPDOWN body.
references.technical_description: The reference emits an ordered IOS XE interface lifecycle over the bundled native syslog receiver and then the separate HEC destination path.
references.business_impact: A modeled campus access path becomes unavailable until the uplink recovers.

references.title: Nexus Fabric Uplink Degradation — NX-OS Reference
references.story: A fictional Nexus fabric uplink reports a documented link failure and subsequent Layer 3 recovery.
references.technical_description: The reference selects documented NX-OS ETHPORT message structures by lifecycle phase without inventing speed or mode suffixes.
references.business_impact: A modeled east-west fabric path is impaired until the uplink recovers.

references.title: Secure Firewall Suspicious Connection Burst — ASA Reference
references.story: A fictional ASA observes a modeled rise in outbound TCP connection creations followed by a teardown event.
references.technical_description: The reference emits Cisco-documented ASA 302013 and 302014 structures with reserved addresses. Rate change is modeled; malicious intent is not asserted.
references.business_impact: Security operators must distinguish an unusual modeled connection-rate increase from normal workload behavior.

references.title: Telecom Operations Network Degradation — Correlated Reference
references.story: A fictional operations campus and carrier edge report a correlated interface disruption on one ordered simulation clock.
references.technical_description: IOS XE and IOS XR source-native syslog structures are generated from one shared state lifecycle while retaining independent device and interface identities.
references.business_impact: A modeled operations path loses reliable connectivity alongside its carrier dependency.
